changes.old: Without an active Oura membership, the ring still tracks activity and basic sleep timing, but most of the metrics that make Oura useful — Sleep Score, Readiness Score, detailed HRV trends, and stage-by-stage breakdowns — are gated behind the subscription. Whoop takes this further: without a membership, the strap essentially doesn't function as a health tracker at all, since Whoop's model bundles the hardware access into the subscription itself. If you're the type of buyer who wants to own a device outright and use it however you like indefinitely, that's a meaningful difference to weigh, and it's part of why some readers decide neither ecosystem is the right fit and opt for a simpler, subscription-free tracker instead.
changes.new: Without an active Oura membership, Oura's support page says you can still see your three daily Oura scores (Readiness, Activity, and Sleep), but the deeper detail behind them, such as the full sleep analysis and 24/7 heart rate, is part of the paid membership. Whoop takes this further: without a membership, the strap essentially doesn't function as a health tracker at all, since Whoop's model bundles the hardware access into the subscription itself. If you're the type of buyer who wants to own a device outright and use it however you like indefinitely, that's a meaningful difference to weigh, and it's part of why some readers decide neither ecosystem is the right fit and opt for a simpler, subscription-free tracker instead. {% whenPublished "smart-ring-no-subscription-oura-alternative" %}We compare ring options in [our guide to smart rings with no subscription]({{ '/posts/smart-ring-no-subscription-oura-alternative/' | url }}).{% endwhenPublished %}
